title: Evaluating the Moral Beliefs Encoded in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a large-scale survey comprising 1,767 hypothetical low-ambiguity and high-ambiguity moral decision-making scenarios to calculate the marginal action likelihood and measure encoded moral preferences/beliefs.

Presenting scenarios using three distinct question templates (A/B, Repeat, and Compare) and randomizing the order of the two possible actions to measure model sensitivity and calculate question-form consistency (QF-C).
